items.title: Register for and withhold Detroit city income tax
items.authority: City of Detroit Income Tax Division / Michigan Department of Treasury
items.description: Employers with a location in Detroit or doing business there register with the city, withhold city income tax monthly or quarterly, and file the annual reconciliation.

items.title: File Detroit corporate or partnership income tax return
items.authority: Michigan Department of Treasury (for the City of Detroit)
items.description: Corporations and partnerships doing business in Detroit file the city return, which the Michigan Department of Treasury has processed since 2017.

items.title: File Flint city income tax withholding reconciliation
items.authority: City of Flint Income Tax Division
items.description: Employers withhold city income tax, file quarterly returns and reconcile annually on Form FW-3 by February 28. From January 1, 2027, business returns move to the Michigan Department of Treasury and withholding becomes monthly.

items.title: File Grand Rapids city income tax business return
items.authority: City of Grand Rapids Income Tax Department
items.description: Corporations (GR-1120) and partnerships (GR-1065) file the city income tax return; calendar-year filers are due April 30 and fiscal-year filers four months after year end.

note: The city's individual income tax return is due April 30; business-specific forms and dates were not confirmed.
